# ona_group_membership (Resource)

Manages one user's or service account's membership in a custom group. Other memberships are left unchanged. Set exactly one of `user_id` or `service_account_id`. Custom groups require the Enterprise plan; membership changes require organization-admin or group-admin permissions.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "ona_group_membership" "developer" {
  group_id = ona_group.platform.id
  user_id  = "<user-id>"
}

resource "ona_group_membership" "ci" {
  group_id           = ona_group.platform.id
  service_account_id = ona_service_account.ci.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `group_id` (String) Group the member belongs to. Changing this value replaces the membership.

### Optional

- `service_account_id` (String) Service account to add to the group. Set exactly one of `service_account_id` or `user_id`. Changing this value replaces the membership.
- `user_id` (String) User to add to the group. Set exactly one of `user_id` or `service_account_id`. Changing this value replaces the membership.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Membership ID returned by the API.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import ona_group_membership.developer '<group-id>/user/<user-id>'
terraform import ona_group_membership.ci '<group-id>/service_account/<service-account-id>'
```
